blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Veteran bowler Chris Ramil ended his three-year wait for another championship by ruling the Sugbuanon Bowlers United (SUGBU) shootout tournament on Sunday, November 8. Ramil topped the four-game series with 896 total pinfalls, repeating his winning performance in April 2023. He finished with 756 scratch pinfalls and 140 handicap pinfalls, at 35 handicap points per game. Ramil’s best performance came in the third game, where he knocked down 279 pins, the highest single-game output of the tournament. A perfect game of bowling is 300 pinfalls.
